headline: OpenAI Restricts Free ChatGPT Usage to Drive Paid Subscriptions
summary: OpenAI has implemented new measures to limit free ChatGPT accounts, compelling users to upgrade to paid plans. This shift is driving a significant change in the AI chatbot market, potentially reducing the number of free users and increasing revenue.
whyItMatters: It signals a new business model for AI services, emphasizing paid subscriptions over free access, which could have broader implications for the industry's revenue streams and user engagement.
